changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE stammtisch_members ADD CONSTRAINT ck_stammtisch_members_board_role CHECK (board_role IS NULL OR board_role IN ('chair', 'treasurer', 'secretary', 'assessor'))

column.name: description
column.value: Verwaltet Mitglieder, Rollen und den Stammtisch

changeSet.author: claude
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO stammtisch_members (id, stammtisch_id, user_id, active, board_role, joined_at, updated_at, version) SELECT id, '${default.stammtisch}', id, TRUE, board_role, created_at, updated_at, 0 FROM users

INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, role, stammtisch_id) SELECT u.id, 'tabletRecorder', '${default.stammtisch}' FROM users u WHERE u.drink_recorder = TRUE AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_roles r WHERE r.user_id = u.id AND r.role = 'tabletRecorder')
ALTER TABLE users DROP CONSTRAINT ck_users_board_role
ALTER TABLE user_roles DROP CONSTRAINT ck_user_roles_role
